name: Mermaid CLI
one_liner: Command-line tool that renders Mermaid diagram files to SVG, PNG, or PDF.
auth_notes: No credentials for the local mmdc CLI or its Node.js run() API. Hosted Mermaid MCP and Mermaid API products are separate and do need an account or token.
access_notes: Open-source package installed locally with npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli. No account, key or cost stated for the CLI.

buildability.rationale: Local OSS CLI (mmdc), not a hosted API. Wrap it as a skill or tool that shells out to mmdc, or call the Node run() API. Hosted Mermaid API (api.mermaid.ai) is a separate product.

identity.quote: It takes a mermaid definition file as input and generates an SVG/PNG/PDF file as output.

api_surface.quote: Please be aware that the NodeJS API is not covered by semver, as mermaid-cli follows

mcp.quote: The Mermaid MCP Server supports multiple transport modes, and every tool call requires authentication with a Mermaid account.

buildability.quote: The mermaid-cli will find the mermaid diagrams, create SVG files from them

needs_human_reason: The Mermaid MCP server (mcp.mermaid.ai) and hosted Mermaid API (api.mermaid.ai) are separate Mermaid Chart products from the OSS CLI. Decide whether they count for this app; the verdict here covers only the local CLI.
